description: Binary assertions for wx-krpano — offline-first 360° virtual-tour production layer (krpano engine) for air-gapped defense use
test_input: dựng tour ảo 360 trưng bày sản phẩm BB-01 giao BQP, đóng gói chạy offline

assertions.name: security_classification_gate_first
assertions.check: a Security/Classification Gate runs FIRST (before capture); MẬT content → air-gapped .exe only, never a 3rd-party/cloud host

assertions.name: offline_first_no_cloud_hosts
assertions.check: offline-first principle — defense content never uploaded to cloud tour hosts (Matterport/Panoee)

assertions.name: krpanotools_droplet_pipeline
assertions.check: wraps the krpanotools CLI + MAKE VTOUR (MULTIRES) droplet / makepano pipeline (not hand-built)

assertions.name: multiresolution_tiling
assertions.check: multiresolution tiling — only necessary tiles loaded, no size limit; tile/VR defaults

assertions.name: dual_runtime_actions_vs_js
assertions.check: dual runtime — XML actions scripting vs JavaScript interface (embedpano / krpano.get('global'))

assertions.name: scene_hotspot_navigation
assertions.check: tour.xml scene structure + navigation hotspot via loadscene

assertions.name: offline_deployment_modes
assertions.check: offline-first deployment modes — NW.js standalone .exe / self-hosted static / localhost / inline

assertions.name: file_protocol_blocked_gotcha
assertions.check: gotcha — opening file:// is blocked; use testserver / .exe / inline

assertions.name: license_register_no_watermark
assertions.check: license handling — register to remove watermark before delivery

assertions.name: four_wx_use_case_templates
assertions.check: 4 WX use-case templates — product showcase / offline BQP kiosk / facility as-built / WebVR training

assertions.name: complements_wx_diagram_not_helix_draw
assertions.check: positioned as complement — wx-krpano (immersive) vs wx-diagram (static) vs helix-draw (internal sketch)
